title: InvalidRequestError when creating new engine with execution_options

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/12284
Originally posted by **craigholm** January 28, 2025 When I try to create a new engine from an existing one (using execution_options), and the existing one has a schema translation map, the operation fails with `sqlalchemy.exc.InvalidRequestError: No such event 'engine_connect' for target`. I'm using SQLAlchemy 2.0.37. I get the same error with SQLite and MySQL. ```python >>> from sqlalchemy import create_engine >>> engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:").execution_options(schema_translate_map={'a':'b'}) >>> engine2 = engine.execution_options(isolation_level='AUTOCOMMIT') Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 1, in engine2 = engine.execution_options(isolation_level='AUTOCOMMIT') File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\engine\base.py", line 3125, in execution_options return self._option_cls(self, opt) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\engine\base.py", line 3339, in __init__ self.update_execution_options(**execution_options) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\engine\base.py", line 3368, in update_execution_options Engine.update_execution_options(self, **opt) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\engine\base.py", line 3030, in update_execution_options self.dialect.set_engine_execution_options(self, opt) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\engine\default.py", line 641, in set_engine_execution_options @event.listens_for(engine, "engine_connect") File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\event\api.py", line 167, in decorate listen(target, identifier, fn, *args, **kw) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\event\api.py", line 123, in listen _event_key(target, identifier, fn).listen(*args, **kw) File "C:\Program Files\Python313\Lib\site-packages\sqlalchemy\event\api.py", line 36, in _event_key raise exc.InvalidRequestError( sqlalchemy.exc.InvalidRequestError: No such event 'engine_connect' for target 'Engine(sqlite:///:memory:)' ```
